name: Wadi Al-Hitan (Whale Valley)
description: In Egypt's Western Desert, about 150 km southwest of Cairo, Wadi Al-Hitan is a dry valley whose sands hold hundreds of fossil whales. They belong to an extinct group that was among the earliest whales. Some skeletons still show tiny hind limbs, a sign of animals in the last stages of leaving their land-living ancestry behind. You can walk among them in open desert.
